summary: Iteration 2 STABILIZATION pass — extended pytest suite from 34 -> 52 cases (51 passed, 1 skipped). All wallet math, kill-switch, RBAC matrix, cross-tenant 404 boundaries, session/token, and 5xx-scan assertions green. Two real bugs found and fixed by testing agent: (1) PATCH /api/compliance/noc/{id} silently returned 200 for cross-tenant items instead of 404 (tenant-isolation leak), (2) wallet recharge invoice_no INV-YYYYMMDDHHMMSS could collide for same-second recharges (uniqueness violation). Frontend smoke: super_admin sidebar=Command|Clients|Alerts (3), client_admin sidebar=Dashboard|Assets|Inspections|Maintenance|Compliance|Risk Map|Emergency|Wallet|Vault|Sites|Users|Alerts (12), all 11 protected routes loaded with 0 console errors, sign-out works.

minor.issue: Accepts negative/zero amount with no validation — silently debits wallet. Documented as MVP known limitation per PRD. Recommend adding `amount > 0` Pydantic constraint.
Originally invoice_no INV-YYYYMMDDHHMMSS could collide on same-second recharges. FIXED: appended -<4HEX> suffix on collision (verified back-to-back recharges now produce unique invoices).
Originally returned 200 even for cross-tenant items (silent no-op). FIXED: now returns 404 when matched_count==0.
Returns hardcoded balance=0 for super_admin instead of aggregate across all clients. Carry-over from iteration 1; non-blocking.

integration_issues.issue: Axios 403 propagates as Uncaught runtime error in dev overlay (React error overlay only — production build hides this). Page does not crash; SSPL dashboard shows loading skeleton. Recommend wrapping admin GETs in try/catch with toast.

action_items: Wrap dashboard axios calls in try/catch+toast so dev error overlay doesn't appear on legitimate 403 (e.g., client_admin hitting /app/sspl)
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 833 lines — split into routers (auth/admin/assets/compliance/wallet) for maintainability.
Wallet recharge has no min-amount validation — negative amounts accepted, debits balance.
PATCH /compliance/noc/{id} now correctly 404s on cross-tenant items (fixed this iteration).
Invoice no format INV-YYYYMMDDHHMMSS now appends -XXXX hex on collision (fixed this iteration).
Per Backlog P0: implement refresh-token rotation + server-side revocation list (logout currently only clears cookies; access token valid full 8h).
JWT secret rotation strategy not documented; consider short-lived access (~30min) + sliding refresh.
test_credentials: Used /app/memory/test_credentials.md — all four demo accounts verified.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_Beta_<hex> client + admin (kept), TEST_Site_<hex>, TEST_OffAsset_<hex>, TEST_user_rbac_<hex>@acme.in, several TEST_Asset_<hex>. Wallet of Acme credited +1502 INR across stabilization tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Two test files now exist: backend_test.py (34 baseline) + test_stabilization.py (18 stabilization). Run: `pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v`. Bugs fixed in this iteration: NOC PATCH 404 and invoice uniqueness. The 'negative recharge accepted' is intentionally documented as known limitation (test skips with reason). super_admin /api/wallet returns 0 by design (aggregation deferred per backlog).
rca_of_the_issues: (1) NOC PATCH bug: server.py L732 used update_one without checking matched_count — returned ok=True even when no doc matched (cross-tenant). Fix: raise 404 if matched_count==0. (2) Invoice collision: L651 used datetime.now().strftime('%Y%m%d%H%M%S') with second-precision; concurrent recharges produced identical INV strings. Fix: probe DB for existing invoice and append uuid hex[:4].upper() suffix on collision. Both fixes verified by re-running pytest (51/51 green). Wallet math proof (numbers): Acme balance before=8000 -> after recharge(+1500)=9500; balance_after in tx=9500; gst_amount=round(1500*0.18/1.18,2)=228.81; invoice format INV-20260422xxxxxx[-XXXX] verified. Kill-switch proof: license_active true->false, beta admin login=403 'Client license suspended by SSPL', super_admin login=200 unaffected, audit_logs has 2 client.kill_switch entries for the cid. Tenant isolation proof: beta admin GET assets/sites/inspections/maintenance/incidents/documents/wallet/compliance.* returns 0 acme records; GET/DELETE/PATCH on Acme asset/maintenance/noc IDs all 404.
